title: Gabriela Mistral y Pablo Neruda: La patria en la poesía
goal: Explore the literary and moral legacies of Chile's two Nobel laureates, Gabriela Mistral and Pablo Neruda.
grammar: análisis lírico comparativo, valoración estética y matrices de certeza frente a subjuntivo

items: Analyze Mistral's rural pedagogical roots in the Elqui Valley and defense of children.
Examine Neruda's oceanic poetry at Isla Negra and celebration of elemental things.
Deploy poetic analysis, rurality, and lyric vocabulary (laureado, lírica, ruralidad, oda).
